import sys
import math

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    pos = [0]
    
    def next_int():
        while pos[0] < len(input_data):
            token = input_data[pos[0]]
            pos[0] += 1
            if token.strip() == '':
                continue
            return int(token)
        raise ValueError("No more input")
    
    mod = 998244353
    n = next_int()
    k = next_int()
    v = [0] * 10
    for _ in range(k):
        x = next_int()
        v[x] = 1
    
    ans = [1]
    p = n // 2
    while True:
        if p % 2 != 0:
            ans = multiply_mod(ans, v, mod)
        p //= 2
        if p == 0:
            break
        v = multiply_mod(v, v, mod)
    
    res = 0
    for x in ans:
        res = (res + x * x) % mod
    print(res)

def multiply_mod(a, b, mod):
    need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    n = max(2, 1 << (need - 1).bit_length())
    
    a_real = [0.0] * n
    a_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(a)):
        x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod
        a_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        a_imaginary[i] = x >> 15
    
    if n == 524288:
        z = 1
    
    fft(a_real, a_imaginary, False)
    
    b_real = [0.0] * n
    b_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    if a == b:
        for i in range(n):
            b_real[i] = a_real[i]
            b_imaginary[i] = a_imaginary[i]
    else:
        for i in range(len(b)):
            x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod
            b_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            b_imaginary[i] = x >> 15
        fft(b_real, b_imaginary, False)
    
    fa_real = [0.0] * n
    fa_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    fb_real = [0.0] * n
    fb_imaginary = [0.0] * n
    
    cf = 0.25 / n
    for i in range(n):
        j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
        
        a1r = (a_real[i] + a_real[j])
        a1i = (a_imaginary[i] - a_imaginary[j])
        a2r = (a_imaginary[i] + a_imaginary[j])
        a2i = (a_real[j] - a_real[i])
        
        b1r = (b_real[i] + b_real[j]) * cf
        b1i = (b_imaginary[i] - b_imaginary[j]) * cf
        b2r = (b_imaginary[i] + b_imaginary[j]) * cf
        b2i = (b_real[j] - b_real[i]) * cf
        
        fa_real[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        fa_imaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        
        fb_real[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        fb_imaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
    
    fft(fa_real, fa_imaginary, True)
    fft(fb_real, fb_imaginary, True)
    
    res = [0] * need
    for i in range(need):
        aa = round(fa_real[i])
        bb = round(fb_real[i])
        cc = round(fa_imaginary[i])
        res[i] = int((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod)
    
    if need + 1 < n and abs(fa_real[need + 1]) > 0.5:
        z = 1
    
    return res

def fft(a, b, inverse):
    n = len(a)
    shift = 32 - (n & -n).bit_length() if n > 0 else 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = reverse_bits(i, shift)
        if i < j:
            a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
            b[i], b[j] = b[j], b[i]
    
    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half_len = length >> 1
        cs = [0.0] * half_len
        sn = [0.0] * half_len
        for i in range(half_len):
            angle = 2 * math.pi * i / length * (-1 if inverse else 1)
            cs[i] = math.cos(angle)
            sn[i] = math.sin(angle)
        
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            for j in range(half_len):
                w_a = cs[j]
                w_b = sn[j]
                
                u_a = a[i + j]
                u_b = b[i + j]
                v_a = a[i + j + half_len] * w_a - b[i + j + half_len] * w_b
                v_b = a[i + j + half_len] * w_b + b[i + j + half_len] * w_a
                a[i + j] = u_a + v_a
                b[i + j] = u_b + v_b
                a[i + j + half_len] = u_a - v_a
                b[i + j + half_len] = u_b - v_b
        
        length <<= 1

def reverse_bits(x, shift):
    return int(bin(x)[2:].zfill(shift)[::-1], 2)

    main()
